# Multi-source input examples

The five names, positions and redshifts are transcribed from the feature proposal
supplied on 2026-11-13. They are not independently verified source metadata or
real duplication verdicts. The TXT is a whitespace rendering of the supplied
CSV example; the original Sebastien file was not provided.

Each row is an independent fixed ICRS Single Pointing target, not one Mosaic
pointing. See [the import contract](../../../docs/multi_source_assessment.md).
